title: Profile and optimize your game's memory
description: Learn how Apple platforms calculate and allocate memory for your game. We'll show you how to use Instruments and the Game Memory template to profile your game, take a memory graph to monitor current memory use, and analyze it using Xcode Memory Debugger and command line tools. We'll also explore Metal resources in Metal Debugger and provide tips and tricks to further help you optimize memory usage.

codeSnippets.title: Available memory for the process
Current and peak footprint
Record an Instruments trace, on a selected device
codeSnippets.code:
xctrace record --device-name "Seth's iPhone" \
						   --template "Game Memory" \
               --attach ModernRenderer \
               --output ModernRenderer.trace \
               --time-limit 30s

codeSnippets.title: MallocStackLogging
codeSnippets.code:
# See `man malloc`.
MallocStackLogging=lite # Live allocations only.
MallocStackLogging=1    # All allocation and free history.

codeSnippets.title: Capture a memory graph
codeSnippets.code:
leaks $PID     --outputGraph foo.memgraph
# or
leaks GameName --outputGraph foo.memgraph
